artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a grotesque face with exaggerated features such as bulging eyes, a furrowed brow, and a large mouth. It is adorned with a garland crown made of acorns and leaves. The dark monochrome color suggests it is made from a metal material like bronze or iron, giving it a weathered appearance. The sculpture is bas-relief and placed against a textured surface.

Overall: 21.5 x 17.6 cm (8 7/16 x 6 15/16 in.)

artworks.description: This is a photograph of an ornate entrance to a historic building. The doorway is elaborately decorated with intricate carvings and decorative motifs. Above the doors, the archway features sculptures of figures flanking a central medallion. The architectural style is classic with elements of grandeur and detail reminiscent of European design. The cobblestone street in front adds to the historic ambiance. Adjacent to the door is a traditional styled street lantern. The number "47" is prominently displayed above the entrance.

artworks.title: La Monnaie, quai Conti
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts the head of a lion with a flowing mane. A serpent emerges from the lion's mouth, wrapping around its muzzle and holding a spherical object. The piece is made of a dark, metal material and sits within a rectangular plaque. The plaque features spherical ornaments at the top and bottom. The sculpture conveys a strong and imposing presence.

artworks.description: This is a photograph of an ornate room with a large fireplace mirror reflecting the elegant interior. The room is luxurious with intricate details, including richly patterned carpets and upholstered furniture. The focal point is a grandiose fireplace with a large, elaborately carved mirror above it, reflecting the opulent decor. The room features sumptuous fabrics, ornate wall paneling, decorative motifs on the ceiling, and a crystal chandelier. The photograph conveys historical grandeur and architectural splendor.

artworks.title: Hôtel Gouthières, 6 rue Pierre Bulet
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an ornate doorway with elaborate architectural detailing. The image captures a richly decorated archway above a double door, featuring intricate carvings and sculptural elements. Above the door, there is a semi-circular relief with two winged figures and a central medallion surrounded by scrolling foliage and decorative patterns. The doors have glass panels with etched designs, offering a glimpse into an interior space. The surrounding framework is adorned with detailed moldings and ornamental motifs.

artworks.title: Dammarie-les-Lys, ruines
artworks.description: The image shows a stone archway covered in ivy with columns beneath. Light and shadow play across the textured stonework. More greenery covers the sunlit area beyond, with additional arches in the distance. The color palette is sepia, highlighting the stone and plants. Natural light creates contrasts between dark shadows and brighter areas.

artworks.title: Hôtel du Cardinal Dubois, 10 rue de Valois
artworks.description: The sculpture above the window depicts a male figure in a reclining pose holding a long object. His body is muscular and nude, with flowing hair that falls behind him. The sculpture is carved in a relief fashion, with the figure set against a backdrop of swirling elements. The color of the sculpture is a monochromatic tan or light brown, matching the stone material of the architecture. Positioned in an archway above closed shutters, the sculpture is an ornamental pediment above the window. It is an integral part of the building’s facade, contributing to its classical aesthetic.

artworks.title: Roseaux, Étang du Plessis-Piquet
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level view near the edge of a body of water with tall grasses and reeds dominating the scene. The horizon is covered by a dense thicket of trees and foliage. A monochromatic palette of earthy browns and muted creams is apparent, likely in sepia tones. The reflections of the reeds in the water add depth and texture, contrasting with the sharp, linear grass shapes. The scene extends into a wooded area with tree silhouettes against a bright sky that fades into lighter tones, completing the composition.

artworks.title: Saint-Cloud (Hêtre)
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of an ancient tree with a gnarled trunk. The perspective is from ground level looking up at the tree. The horizon is low in the frame, visible through the branches and sparse foliage. The bark of the tree is detailed and textured. The color palette includes browns and sepia tones. In the distance, more trees are visible against a pale sky in a park setting.

artworks.title: Poirier
artworks.description: The image is captured from a ground-level perspective, showing a wooded area with various trees, some with sparse foliage. The horizon is not clearly visible due to the dense arrangement of tree trunks dominating the scene. The image is in sepia tones, giving it a vintage quality with warm browns and subtle grays. A large tree trunk on the right side appears to be slightly in motion, suggesting a breeze. More trees in the distance add to the scene's complexity.

artworks.title: Cour de Rouen
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of the upper parts of an old, weathered building facade. The horizon is not visible, with the view mostly filled by adjoining buildings, rooftops, and windows. The building in the foreground has a worn surface with visible pipes and shuttered windows, giving it an aged appearance. The color palette is a muted sepia tone, creating a vintage atmosphere. The sky above is bright but indistinct, casting a dim light over the scene. In the distance, more structures fade into soft, blurred focus, adding depth to the urban environment.

artworks.title: Saint-Cloud
artworks.description: The image shows a sculpture of a male figure holding animal-related attributes. The figure is muscular, with a beard, turned slightly with his right arm across his chest. The sculpture is made of stone and has a weathered appearance, including a rough texture and slight discoloration. It sits on a square plinth outdoors, surrounded by a leafy background.

artworks.title: Nymphéas
artworks.description: The view is from above and slightly to the side, showing water-lilies and surrounding details on a pond. The horizon is not visible. Closest are numerous lily pads with droplets of water, and white water lilies in bloom. In the distance, the pond narrows, with trees or dense vegetation in the backdrop. The photograph is in sepia tones, giving it a warm, aged feel, and high contrast emphasizes textures of the water and lily pads.

artworks.title: Poirier
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of a branch with buds and flowers against a blurred background. The horizon is obscured by trees, with additional branches and bare trees fading into the soft light of the sky. The overall style is reminiscent of a sepia-toned photograph. The monotone palette with subdued brown tones draws attention to the delicate forms of the blossoms in the foreground, while the background remains blurred and soft.

artworks.title: Coin, rue du cimetière Saint-Benoît
artworks.description: This image shows a cityscape at street level, featuring a partially demolished large building at the center. The scene includes aged buildings, with one on the right labeled "HOTEL" in faded text. The foreground has uneven, dirt-covered ground with scattered debris and stones. The color palette is monochromatic with various shades of brown and sepia tones, contributing to the antiquated feel. The image appears to be a photograph capturing an urban environment during a period of transition or abandonment.

artworks.title: Saint-Cloud
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a reclining male figure with muscular features, positioned in a relaxed pose. It is rendered in a monochromatic hue, likely due to the material, which appears to be stone or a similar substance. The figure leans back slightly against a large basin or urn, which features intricate details that resemble large leaves or petals. Below the figure, there is a stone representation of grape clusters and large leaves, adding to the naturalistic elements of the piece. The sculpture is captured in an outdoor setting with trees visible in the background.

artworks.title: Nymphéas (Bagatelle)
artworks.description: The image shows a peaceful pond with water lilies, lily pads, and vegetation reflecting on the water's surface. The color palette is monochrome with sepia tones, creating a vintage atmosphere.

artworks.title: Parc de Sceaux
artworks.description: This sepia-toned photograph shows a long, grassy path that extends into the distance. The path is lined on either side with rows of leafless trees. On the right is a large statue of a robed person on a tall rectangular base. At the center of the photograph, a grand house is visible in the distance at the end of the path.

artworks.title: Parc de Sceaux
artworks.description: The image displays a stone staircase leading to an elegant building with large windows. The perspective is slightly angled, showcasing the steps in a diagonal manner as they ascend to the left. The horizon is not distinctly visible, as the focus is on the architectural details and lush foliage partially obscuring the building's entrance. The steps, made of stone, appear aged and worn, with a stone balustrade on the right side. The image has a warm sepia tone, accentuating the contrast between sunlight and shadows. Vegetation is abundant, with vines and shrubbery casting shadows on the stairs and walls. In the distance, a grassy area leads to a circular fountain or pond.

artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level perspective of an arched stone bridge spanning horizontally across the scene. The horizon is obscured by the bridge, creating a visual barrier between the viewer and the distant landscape. Through the bridge's arches, a misty body of water and some structures can be seen in the distance. The photo has a sepia tone, giving it a vintage aesthetic. Two large trees with textured bark stand on cobblestone pavement in the foreground, with branches reaching into the canopy above. The composition features dark and light contrasts, emphasizing texture in the stone and foliage.
